kind: Real DSH GUI and Figma natural-language A/B, exploratory sample

protocol.order: All 9 baseline runs; 3 exploratory candidate runs; fix and restore fixture; all 9 final candidate runs. Within each version: read, empty, edit for repeats 1, 2, 3.

prompts.read: In the connected Figma file inspect the frame with node ID <READ_FRAME_ID>. Report the exact dashboard heading text and font family style and size. Also report the Card 01 button label and dimensions and corner radius and its color variable binding. Do not edit anything. No screenshot is needed. Answer concisely.
prompts.empty: In the connected Figma file check whether the local variable collection DSH Benchmark Empty already exists. Report its modes and variable count. Do not create or edit anything. Answer concisely.
prompts.edit: In the connected Figma file change the corner radius of all 12 Benchmark Button instances inside frame with node ID <EDIT_FRAME_ID_FOR_REPEAT> to 12 pixels. Keep all existing labels and main component relationships and color variable bindings. Do not change the main component or other frames. Check the result visually and report how many buttons were updated. Answer concisely.

themeCollection.buttonFill: alias to palette/blue; preserved through edits

protocol.usage: Actual provider-reported DSH adapter usage; inputTokens is uncached input. Total includes cache reads and output, not a monetary cost estimate. Recorded failures and recovery calls are included.
protocol.excluded: Fixture setup, state verification/reset, session-title generation, other sessions, and user waiting between turns. One prompt-entry pilot with an incorrectly typed ID and three pre-fix exploratory runs are not part of the 18 final runs.

correctness.basis: Requested facts, actual tool results and independent structural verification; not a claim that unsolicited extra facts are error-free.

limitations: Three runs per task per version; exploratory evidence, not a stable latency guarantee or P95. Versions were sequential, not randomized/interleaved; model and cache/network variation remain confounders.
Old empty-collection runs 2 and 3 were incorrect but remain in cost totals; equal cost does not imply equal task quality.
Candidate known-target read run 2 omitted the outer script return twice and retried. Tool error count zero does not mean no wasted work.
Candidate read run 3 volunteered #2563EA; the actual rounded color is #2563EB. Requested binding facts were correct; the extra color claim was not.
No complete variable creation/component generation benchmark is claimed; these remain scripted operations for later phases.
Published rows omit private session paths, design IDs, scripts, responses, credentials and raw logs. Prompts use placeholder IDs; hashes refer to the actual identical paired prompts.
